CustomField.description: Picto list representing the plaforms size 24 pix (list view purpose)
CustomField.formula: TRIM( IF(ISBLANK(Text(Account.Status__c)),'',IMAGE('/resource/accountStatus/'+Text(Account.Status__c)+'.svg',Text(Account.Status__c), 24, 24)) + ' ' + IF(OR(ISBLANK( extId_1__c ), ISPICKVAL(Account.extStatus_1__c, 'ended')),'',IMAGE('/resource/systemIcons/1'+IF(AND(NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Account.extStatus_1__c))), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Account.extStatus_1__c, 'active'))),'_disabled','')+'.svg', extId_1__c, 24, 24)) + ' ' + IF(OR(ISBLANK( extId_2__c ), ISPICKVAL(Account.extStatus_2__c, 'ended')),'',IMAGE('/resource/systemIcons/2'+IF(AND(NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Account.extStatus_2__c))), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Account.extStatus_2__c, 'active'))),'_disabled','')+'.svg', extId_2__c, 24, 24)) + ' ' + IF(OR(ISBLANK( extId_3__c ), ISPICKVAL(Account.extStatus_3__c, 'ended')),'',IMAGE('/resource/systemIcons/3'+IF(AND(NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Account.extStatus_3__c))), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Account.extStatus_3__c, 'active'))),'_disabled','')+'.svg', extId_3__c, 24, 24)) + ' ' + IF(OR(ISBLANK( extId_4__c ), ISPICKVAL(Account.extStatus_4__c, 'ended')),'',IMAGE('/resource/systemIcons/4'+IF(AND(NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Account.extStatus_4__c))), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Account.extStatus_4__c, 'active'))),'_disabled','')+'.svg', extId_4__c, 24, 24)) + ' ' + IF(OR(ISBLANK( extId_5__c ), ISPICKVAL(Account.extStatus_5__c, 'ended')),'',IMAGE('/resource/systemIcons/5'+IF(AND(NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Account.extStatus_5__c))), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Account.extStatus_5__c, 'active'))),'_disabled','')+'.svg', extId_5__c, 24, 24)) + ' ' + IF(OR(ISBLANK( extId_6__c ), ISPICKVAL(Account.extStatus_6__c, 'ended')),'',IMAGE('/resource/systemIcons/6'+IF(AND(NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Account.extStatus_6__c))), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Account.extStatus_6__c, 'active'))),'_disabled','')+'.svg', extId_6__c, 24, 24)) )
